scope: Original signed attribution proof and completed degree2 attribution001 diagnostic; excludes subsequently appended basis intervention.

proof_review.identity: (J+dJ)^T(r+dr)-J^T r = J^T dr + dJ^T r + dJ^T dr. Substitute dr=sum_p dr_p and dJ=sum_p dJ_p: diagonal terms are one-group replacement vectors, and unordered off-diagonal pairs give dJ_p^T dr_q+dJ_q^T dr_p. Exact real algebra.
proof_review.partition: RC1/2/3 include each initial-state/resistance pair and its log-tau column. Joint H includes H/B and both directional log-rate columns; no false separation of directional response histories. At fixed shape residuals are affine in amplitudes, so amplitude-Jacobian column defects times original amplitudes produce group residual defects. Nominally exact columns leave only measured floating-point closure error.
proof_review.chain_derivative: Amplitude chart derivative holds tau and gamma/Q fixed, including Q-induced gamma changes. Shape derivative differentiates log physical tau and log gamma/Q through ordered gaps. Direct D propagates by F at every chunk. Candidate features remain at original coordinates. This is the correct chain rule.
proof_review.independence_truth: Direct C predictions/Jacobians are independent of response collocation/projection but share the stationary physical model; they are not independent physical validation. Queries and center are inherited from frozen public baseline. Generator truth output is discarded and never used in objectives or query selection.
proof_review.once_only_evidence: Each accumulator consumes new chronological rows once. Prefixes reuse the same cumulative history only for diagnostics; no prior/posterior message is added. Baseline replay and many queries remain paired evidence, not independent observations.

independent_checks.stimulus: Variable1/35 or2/35 second intervals, reversing+0.06/-0.04 A, varying temperature; public query20.

validation.raw_checks: All case files equal summary entries; nine observation digests equal bound followup002 prefixes; baseline-result and registered-source hashes match.

findings.finding: H is largest on302 of306 active-load queries and has the largest group maximum at all active prefixes. Four early queries rank RC3 first. Rest group maxima are RC3; near-roundoff rest ranks carry no physical significance.
findings.disposition: Accept H-focused separate intervention; avoid universal per-query dominance.

findings.finding: Group norms are not additive fractions. H one-group maximum0.685229 exceeds total maximum0.575587 because signed cancellation is possible.
findings.disposition: Protocol and output preserve signed vectors and six interactions; do not interpret ratios as uncertainty or fitted bias.

findings.finding: Runner filters out outcome-selected domain-exit diagnostic. Refusal evidence is inherited from baseline; no new refusal check is implied.
findings.disposition: No blocker to attribution; new basis must separately check refusal/source/order/invalid-update behavior.

findings.finding: Four-group implementation omits floating errors in nominally exact columns; these remain in measured closure.
findings.disposition: Accept real-algebra proof and approximate numerical reconstruction, not exact floating-point equality.

limits: Finite public probes and short derivative fixtures are not uniform response/gradient bounds.
Normalized gradients at unfitted queries do not establish fitted SOC/Q/RC accuracy, calibrated coverage, posterior validity or causal health attribution.
No basis intervention, aging, lifetime availability, target timing, complete SRAM budget or default promotion accepted.
Seven inherited tests cover controls. No persistent attribution-specific test module existed at this review time; independent reviewer checks cover new expansion and chain use.
acceptance: Accept conditional algebra and completed diagnostic interpretation as support for separately registered H-focused response-basis experiment. Require separate independent review of new basis and results.
